text:
maria: Heads up — PR #4829 is blocked by CI. linux-integ shard3 is failing repeatedly with a kv timeout + a render snapshot diff. Anyone available for a quick look? @kevin 

ci-bot: Buildkite: PR #4829 — build 4829 failed on shard3: 
- tests/render_snapshot_test.py::test_widget_layout — AssertionError (pixel diff > 3%)
- infra: timeout waiting for kv (30s)

kevin: On it. Can you paste the failing log snippet and the last changed files? If it's nondet I can trigger a targeted rerun.

maria: Pasted logs below:
```
FAIL tests/render_snapshot_test.py::test_widget_layout
AssertionError: pixels differ > 3%
  at tests/render_snapshot_test.py:128
  last output: /artifacts/4829/shard3/snapshots/widget_layout.png
  env: RANDOM_SEED=unset
Stack: ...
```
Changed files: engine/layout.py, engine/metrics.py, tests/snapshots/widget_layout.expected.png (no intentional update)

olivia: I've seen this crop up after the layout refactor — sometimes rebase changes floating point order. Two things to check: 1) rerun the shard to see if it's flakey, 2) if deterministic change, update snapshot with QA note.

sam: I can approve once CI is stable. If you want a quick check run: `./scripts/ci rerun --target=shard3 --build=4829` — I can kick it off or kevin can.

kevin: Kicking a targeted rerun now. 
ci-bot: Rerun requested: build 4829 -> targeted shard3 run id 7890. ETA ~8m.

maria: Quick note — this PR touches the layout engine, prefer to bisect or at least confirm flake twice before accepting a snapshot update.

olivia: +1. If rerun is green once but not twice, we shouldn't update the expected image. @sam please hold approval until we see a second green.

ci-bot: shard3 run id 7890 PASSED (rerun #1).

kevin: One green. Starting a second targeted rerun to confirm flake.

ci-bot: Rerun requested: build 4829 -> shard3 run id 7891.

ci-bot: shard3 run id 7891 PASSED (rerun #2). Both reruns green — indicates a flaky test.

ci-bot: Note: kv timeout did not reproduce on reruns.

maria: Looks flaky. I'll open a short ticket to pin the test seed and add an explicit seed in the harness. I'll push a tiny test-fix commit (set RANDOM_SEED=42 in the test setup) to the branch.

olivia: Sounds good. When you push the fix, run a final full CI or targeted shards to be safe.

maria: Pushed fix -> branch updated. Re-triggered CI.

ci-bot: Build 4833 started (post-fix). Running full matrix.

ci-bot: Build 4833 shard3 PASSED, all other shards PASSED.

sam: LGTM. I'll merge after the branch rebase is clean. Please add the test ticket reference in the PR body.

maria: Added ticket #INF-902 to PR description and rebased. Ready for merge.

sam: :thumbsup: merging now.

ci-bot: Merge completed: PR #4829 merged into main (merge commit 0a1b2c).

maria: Thanks all — filing follow-up to sweep other snapshot tests for nondet seeds.
